title: Polish Plum Crumble
description: A German-inspired dessert featuring sweet plums, a crunchy crumble topping, and a hint of polish flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sliced plums, granulated sugar, and polish vanilla sugar.
Transfer the plum mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour, rolled oats, and brown sugar.
Add the cold butter to the dry ingredients and mix until crumbly.
Spread the crumble topping evenly over the plum mixture.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is tender.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
